the pricing of its private offering of $3.7B aggregate principal amount of its 2.875% convertible senior notes due 2033.
The offering was upsized from the previously announced offering of $3B aggregate principal amount of Notes.
The issuance and sale of the Notes are scheduled to settle on September 22, 2026.
The Notes will mature on April 1, 2033, unless earlier repurchased, redeemed or converted.
The initial conversion rate will be 10.2194 shares of CoreWeave’s Class A common stock per $1,000 principal amount of Notes, which represents an initial conversion price of ~$97.85 per share.

title: CoreWeave prices upsized $3.7B convertible senior notes offering
